# MyVendor\Cms

API Document

## Routes (13)

| HTTP Route | Methods | Resource |
|------------|---------|----------|
| /article | GET, POST, PUT, DELETE | App/Article |
| /articles | GET | App/Articles |
| /auth | GET, POST | App/Auth |
| /author | GET, POST, PUT | App/Author |
| /categories | GET | App/Categories |
| /category | GET, POST, PUT, DELETE | App/Category |
| /media | GET, POST, DELETE | App/Media |
| /tag | GET, POST, DELETE | App/Tag |
| /tags | GET | App/Tags |
| /variations/article-as-array | GET | App/Variations/ArticleAsArray |
| /variations/article-raw-pdo | GET | App/Variations/ArticleRawPdo |
| /variations/article-sql-query | GET | App/Variations/ArticleSqlQuery |
| /variations/media-stream | GET | App/Variations/MediaStream |

## ResourceObjects (13)

### App/Article
`/article`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | href(goArticleList), href(goAuthor), href(goCategory), src(author), src(category), src(tagList) |
| POST | slug*, title*, body*, authorId*, categoryId*, excerpt, status, publishedAt, tagIds | - |
| PUT | id*, title*, body*, status*, excerpt, publishedAt, tagIds | - |
| DELETE | id* | - |

### App/Articles
`/articles`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | page, perPage, categoryId, tagId, authorId, status | href(goArticle) |

### App/Auth
`/auth`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | - | - |
| POST | code*, state* | - |

### App/Author
`/author`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | href(goArticleList) |
| POST | name*, email*, bio | - |
| PUT | id*, name*, email*, bio | - |

### App/Categories

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | - | href(goCategory) |

### App/Category
`/category`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | href(goCategoryList), href(goArticleList) |
| POST | slug*, name*, description, parentId | - |
| PUT | id*, name*, description, parentId | - |
| DELETE | id* | - |

| Method | Parameters | Links |

## Responses (10)

| Response | Schema | Properties |
|----------|--------|------------|
| Article | article.json | id, slug, title, body, excerpt, status, publishedAt, authorId, categoryId |
| Write_response | write_response.json | id, slug, email, filename, message |
| ArticleList | articleList.json | items, page, perPage, count, totalCount |
| Auth_response | auth_response.json | id, email, name, message, reason |
| Author | author.json | id, name, email, bio |
| CategoryList | categoryList.json | items, totalCount |
| Category | category.json | id, slug, name, description, parentId |
| Media | media.json | id, filename, mimeType, url, alt, width, height |
| Tag | tag.json | id, slug, name |
| TagList | tagList.json | items, totalCount |

## Query Interfaces (12)

| Interface | Methods |
|-----------|---------|
| ArticleCommandInterface | add(slug, title, body, excerpt, status, publishedAt, authorId, categoryId):void, update(id, title, body, excerpt, status, publishedAt):void, delete(id):void |
| ArticleQueryInterface | item(id):Article, bySlug(slug):Article, list(categoryId, tagId, authorId, status, perPage):PagesInterface |
| ArticleSelectionQueryInterface | list(status):ArticleSelection |
| ArticleTagCommandInterface | clear(articleId):void, link(articleId, tagId):void |
| AuthorCommandInterface | add(name, email, bio):void, update(id, name, email, bio):void |
| AuthorQueryInterface | item(id):Author, byEmail(email):Author, list():array |
| CategoryCommandInterface | add(slug, name, description, parentId):void, update(id, name, description, parentId):void, delete(id):void |
| CategoryQueryInterface | item(id):Category, bySlug(slug):Category, list():array |
| MediaCommandInterface | add(filename, mimeType, url, alt, width, height):void, delete(id):void |
| MediaQueryInterface | item(id):Media, byFilename(filename):Media |
| TagCommandInterface | add(slug, name):void, delete(id):void |
| TagQueryInterface | item(id):Tag, bySlug(slug):Tag, list():array, listByArticle(articleId):array |
